title: feat(objectql, runtime)!: object-less action names held per namespace, and a call that names no package is refused in the two declared holder cases (ADR-0150 child B)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBDjNZzBTDGVQoXhCdngfjXY)_

Fixes #31697

Supersedes #32101

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — a call that names no package is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, naming every holder, where it ran one of them on base, in exactly the two declared cases (epic ruling 6762267053 item 1): two packages hold the action on one key (an object, or the object-less key; ruling 6729825528 letter A), and, on the object-less key only, a package's beside host code or a plugin's (the G2 obligation 6742974046). The doors: `ObjectQL.executeAction` with no `packageId`; the bare `POST /actions/:object/:action` and the MCP bare `run_action`; `GET /meta/action/NAME` for an object-less action; and, in process, the metadata service's own `get` / `getDiagnosed('action', NAME)` naming no package, for a name two packages hold (epic B-shape item 1, below). A package declaring the object-less action `install_package`, now a built-in name, is refused at install (epic ruling 6762267053 item 2 (b)). First-party count: 0. The install side widens: two packages of two namespaces may each declare one object-less action name. Console's bare calls to such a name answer 409 until Console carries the package.
Metadata-protocol: added
Narrowing: yes — the refusals above; measured first-party 0 on showcase, crm and multi-package (census on #32101, unchanged), and no first-party package declares `install_package`.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：无对象动作按命名空间各持一个名字；不写包名的调用只在两种已申报情形下返回 409 并列出全部持有者（同一键上两个包；无对象键上包与宿主代码或插件并存），其余维持原状。元数据服务的内存仓把 action 按「包 + 名」分槽，两个包的同名动作都保留。
- 为什么改：接手 #32101 的补丁轮，修合约评审 6762242732 的 F1–F7，并执行史诗裁定 6762108144 与 6762267053（引擎收回到申报范围、Console 裸调用的声明与内置名）。
- 风险与回滚：仍是收窄，首方计数为 0；新增两处行为变化已在 changeset 申报（REST 与 MCP 对同对象两声明给出同一答案；清单读失败时裸 REST 返回 503）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` 的 `bareRouteHolderRefusal`、`pickActionHolder`、`environmentStoredActionNames`，`packages/objectql/src/engine-actions.ts` 的 `unqualifiedHandler`，`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `refuseAmbiguousObjectLessAction`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/actions-addressed-route.test.ts src/action-package-addressing.test.ts` 与 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/bound-action-collision-report.test.ts src/plugin-authored-actions.test.ts`，应全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无；席位关闭 #32101 并做合约复审，史诗席位只读增量。

## Patch round

This PR continues #32101 from its head `921ec56a` (merged with `origin/main` at `45f0f81f`, no rebase) and answers the contract review 6762242732 (VERDICT FAIL) and the epic rulings 6762108144 and 6762267053. #32101's body (census, positions, forced test changes, overlap) still holds except where this section says otherwise.

| Finding / ruling | Change | Pin (ablation) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **F1** (must-fix; epic 6762108144 "Deviation 1 must change") | `bareRouteHolderRefusal`: a capability that is absent judges nothing — no `protocol` with `getMetaItems` and no `metadata` service with `listObjects`/`loadMany`, a `resolveService` that does not resolve, or a protocol whose own engine registers no `sys_metadata` object (no store behind its listing; every served kernel registers it). Once the capability is there, a listing read that throws answers `degraded` (503), never the rungs. Measured on the first fail-closed draft: 31 runtime tests in 10 files went red. 28 compose a bare `ObjectQL` with no `sys_metadata` (their listing threw `OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` for it); they fall through as before. One was this patch's own docblock spelling the object-less key as a literal (fixed). Two are `action-handler-owner-gates.test.ts`'s plane-down cases, a metadata service whose listing throws: they now expect 503, nothing run (forced test change; it ran the action's own handler before). | `actions-addressed-route.test.ts` "the bare door's holder rule when the listing read throws": protocol listing throws → 503, nothing run; metadata listing throws → 503; CONTROL no capability → the rungs answer. A3: `catch` back to `return undefined` → 2 red. |
| **F2** | With two or more declarations on the route's key, the bare REST door serves the declaration `pickActionHolder` chose, the one MCP's bare `run_action` serves. Declared in the changeset: a package's embedded action beside the environment's own stored row of the same object and name now answers the environment's on both doors (ADR-0150 D3); on base both answered the embedded one. The changeset sentence "then it answers first, as before" is corrected. | "an object-bound pair of a package's and the environment's: both bare doors serve the environment's": REST and MCP both answer the environment's gated declaration (403). A4: drop the served holder → red. |
| **F3** | `refuseAmbiguousObjectLessAction(name, readStoredRows)` classifies a package-less object-less item as the protocol's other doors do: the environment's only when the environment's store holds an active package-less row of the name that is itself object-less (the protocol's by-name row read, `readItemActiveRows`), else the platform's, refused beside a package naming both. It reads every package-less entry of the bare slot, because the registry reads one over a held name as that holder's overlay, which only the environment's row is. `readMetaItem` passes the reader. | runtime `action-package-addressing.test.ts` "[#31697 review F3]": host item beside a package → 409, candidates `[package A, platform]`; a stored row bound to an object does not make it the environment's. CONTROL (amended): the environment's own stored row answers first. A9 (objectql rebuilt under hold): platform branch never taken → red. |
| **F4** | A disabled package is no holder at `/meta/action/NAME`'s refusal (holders and items both filtered by `isPackageDisabled`), as the merged listings withhold it. The bare REST door's by-name rung reads a thrown `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (or its 409 + `refusal` shape) as a refusal, never `degraded`. | "[#31697 review F4] a disabled package holds nothing": the bare read and the bare REST door answer the enabled holder, not degraded. "the bare REST door reads the by-name read's refusal as a refusal". A10 (both filters, objectql rebuilt under hold) → red; A7: refusal read as degraded again → red. |
| **F5** | The source classifier keys a stored row by its identity: a standalone row by `OWNER:NAME` (its owner key and name), an embedded row by `OBJECT:NAME` of an object row that embeds that action. It also leaves a legacy organization's rows out (`readLegacyOrganizationRows`), as the resync does, and reads the legacy plural `actions` when no `action` row exists. | "[review F5] a package-less row the store holds on ANOTHER object does not make this one the environment's". A5: match by bare name again → red. |
| **F6 / F7 + epic ruling 2 (a)** | The PR body (above) and the changeset declare under the widening: "Console's bare calls to such a name answer 409 until Console carries the package". The follow-up — Console addresses an action by its app's package (`useNavActionDispatch`'s `getItem('action', name)`, `consoleServerAction.ts`'s `/actions/OBJECT/ACTION` URL, the activation write in Setup's packaged actions) — belongs on #31527 per ruling 2 (a), not in a new issue; I did not file it. At this head #31527 does not record it yet (its comments through 6766935846 name no Console follow-up), so the epic seat records it. | (declaration only) |
| **Epic ruling 2 (b)** | Census of fixed-name action calls in the platform's own code (`packages/**/src`, `ui/**/src`, no tests): one, `POST /actions/sys_package/install_package` (`marketplaceApi.ts`, `cloud-connection-plugin.ts`). Every other Console action call is a name read from metadata. `install_package` joins `BUILT_IN_BARE_NAMES.action`, so no package can hold the object-less name that reaches `sys_package`'s route. The object-bound key `sys_package:install_package`: platform objects are referenceable, so a package can bind an action there; after ruling 1 a single package beside the platform's declaration is not refused, so one more holder never turns the button into a 409. Two packages both binding it would be refused by ruling A's letter (see Acceptance notes). | request-family "the action the platform's own UI calls by a fixed name is a built-in": the set is `['install_package']` and a package declaring it is refused naming the built-in. A8: empty the set → red. |
| **Epic ruling 1** (pull the engine back) | `unqualifiedHandler` refuses only two packages on one key, or, on the object-less key, a package beside host code or a plugin. Host code or a plugin beside ONE package on an object-bound key runs the last registration, as on base. Both #30542 pins in `plugin-authored-actions.test.ts` are restored byte for byte. The declaration doors follow the same scope: `pickActionHolder` counts the platform only on the object-less key; on an object-bound key beside a platform declaration the first declaration answers, as on base. | `bound-action-collision-report.test.ts` "on the object-less key, host code … refused" (A1 → red) and "on an object-bound key, host code or a plugin beside ONE package is not refused" (A2: refuse on any key → red); `actions-addressed-route.test.ts` "the platform beside one package on an object-bound key is not refused" (A6: count the platform on any key → red). |
| **Epic B-shape item 1** (6766935846; seat call) | `action` joins `PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES` beside `api` (`packages/metadata/src/package-slotted-store.ts`), in the same stroke as its `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` entry. Every rule the set drives was already in place for `api` (#32092). Measured on an artifact-door boot of two namespaces (base = the set entry ablated, metadata rebuilt): base answered every read the package registered last, and `/meta/action/NAME?package=alpha` served beta's body stamped alpha; head answers each package its own and lists both, and the in-process bare `get` of a two-holder name is 409 naming both. The store keys an action by its name, so two packages' same-named actions on two different objects are slotted too: their `?package=` reads are fixed the same way, and the bare `GET /meta/action/NAME` stays 200 but serves the package registered first (the registry's step) where it served the survivor. Declared in the changeset; `@objectstack/metadata` joins it (minor). | `metadata-manager-action-slots.test.ts`: both items kept, by-package reads each its own (plural spelling too), a non-holder nothing, bare `get`/`getDiagnosed` 409 `ambiguous-in-environment` naming both; CONTROLs one holder and a non-slotted type (`flow`). A11: set back to `['api']` → 4 red, both CONTROLs green. Dogfood `action-slotted-store-artifact.dogfood.test.ts` (artifact door): A12 (held, metadata rebuilt, the marker found in its dist) → 3 red, the one-holder CONTROL green; restored and rebuilt → 4/4. |
| B shape on the merge | `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` on `origin/main` holds `agent`, `skill`; this PR adds `action`. No other B card has landed since. | ai-family switch pin (unchanged from #32101). |

Every ablation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; each restore printed blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. A9 and A10 held the mutation, rebuilt `@objectstack/objectql`, ran the runtime pin, restored and rebuilt; the runtime file then ran 18/18.

## Acceptance notes

- **Two packages binding `install_package` to `sys_package`** (seat call: ruling A stands, not built). After this PR a package beside the platform's declaration is not refused (ruling 1 scope), but two packages both binding `install_package` to `sys_package` are refused by ruling A's letter. `BUILT_IN_BARE_NAMES` covers only the object-less name. This is a noted limit.
- **Removal by slot** (epic B-shape item 2): not built here. It rides #32198, the generic mechanism (`unregisterPackage` / `unregisterAt` by `(package, name)`), never a per-type fork.
- **A host (package-less) action item over a package-held name reads back as that package's overlay** at `?package=`: that is ADR-0150 D4 by design (a package-less row bearing a package-held name is the holder's customization), not a defect.
- **Epic B-shape item 4**: `action` has no metadata redactor (only connector, datasource and flow register one), so `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` is never reached for it. **Item 5**: F4 above withholds a disabled package at the by-name door; the install gate is unchanged and keeps counting it.
- **`composeStacks` lags the widening** (out of scope, found by the dogfood above): composing two stacks that each declare the same object-less action refuses with `StackComposeActionKeyCollisionError` ("only one of these handlers would be reachable"), though the engine now keeps one handler slot per package. The dogfood builds each package's body apart in the compiled artifact instead. Not changed here (`packages/spec`); left to the seat whether it becomes a card.
- **Console follow-up (ruling 2 (a))**: the epic seat records it on #31527; the body's declaration stands.
